page.overview:
Who is Jailer?

Jailer belongs to Avatar: The Last Airbender. The jailer encountered and battled Team Avatar in an attempt to prevent them from successfully breaking out of prison along with Lian.

He was a powerful firebender, though his main attacks were basic fire blasts and lines of fire. Eventually, he was defeated by Aang when the young airbender ran around him repeatedly, only attacking when the jailer took it upon himself to rest.

In Avatar: The Last Airbender, Jailer sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
